vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: gh-envcheck
Version: 0.1.1

The gh-envcheck skill is a standard utility designed to verify environment readiness by checking for the existence of environment variables and CLI binaries. The code in envcheck/app.py only returns the names of the variables found, not their values, preventing data exfiltration, and uses safe methods like shutil.which for binary detection. No malicious instructions or suspicious behaviors were identified.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and install steps match its description: it runs a small local FastAPI service that checks whether named environment variables and binaries exist on PATH.

dimensions.detail: Name/description ask for an environment readiness checker and the package files (FastAPI app and Pydantic models) implement exactly that. Required binary (python) and listed Python packages align with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running a local uvicorn server and posting lists of env var names and binary names to check. This is in-scope, but the service will respond whether arbitrary env var names are present — which is expected functionality but could reveal presence/absence of sensitive env names if the server is reachable by untrusted parties.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install spec requests common Python packages (fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic) which matches the SKILL.md pip install instructions. No downloads from untrusted URLs or extract steps are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request any credentials or require environment variables. It reads only the env variable names provided in each request (as intended). Be aware that, if exposed to untrusted clients, the endpoint can be used to probe whether specific env vars or binaries exist on the host.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request persistent elevated privileges, always:true is not set, and it does not attempt to modify other skills or system configuration. It runs as a normal local web service when started.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be what it says: a small local service to check env vars and CLI binaries. Before installing/starting it: (1) run it bound to localhost (do not expose it publicly) so remote parties cannot probe your environment, (2) avoid including sensitive env var names in requests when untrusted clients can reach the service, and (3) install the declared Python packages (fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic) in a virtualenv to avoid affecting system packages.
